###############################################################################
# Power Without War: UI lane data (Trade Desk, Dossier, alert strip)
#
# The GUIs (interface/pww_ui.gui, scripted_guis/pww_ui_guis.txt, generated by
# tools/pww_ui_gen.py) only read variables. Everything they show is derived
# here from the other lanes' public records; this lane never writes them.
#
# Entry points
#   pww_ui_on_daily     on_daily, any country. Human players only: rebuild the
#                       country summaries when the ledger queue moved, then
#                       pww_ui_refresh.
#   pww_ui_on_monthly   on_monthly, any country. Once per 28+ days: market
#                       report and country summaries.
#   pww_ui_refresh      country scope (a human). Rebuilds that player's slots
#                       and the per-viewer marks on counterparts. Also runs on
#                       every GUI click that changes what is shown.
#
# Per player (the viewer)
#   pww_ui_dirty        dirty variable of every pww_ui GUI (+1 per refresh)
#   pww_ui_ns           live Situations shown (0..4), slots pww_ui_s<k>_*:
#                       id seat tmpl res days phase tstate pledge dev hasp
#                       cl ho pa (countries) date (date value) kind (alert row:
#                       0 claimant, 1 cornered, 2 ready to fold, 3 holder
#                       facing a demand, 4 holder writing lots, 5 patron, 6
#                       patron pledged, 7 lease renewal)
#   pww_ui_focus        slot highlighted in the desk (-1 none)
#   pww_ui_tab          desk tab 0 Overview, 1 Deals, 2 Reserves;
#                       pww_ui_tabf<t> tab sprite frame (2 selected, 1 not)
#   pww_ui_nc           cartel rows (0..3), slots pww_ui_c<k>_*: id res frame
#                       status anchor pct (cartel price over market, %) cb
#                       (cohesion band) n nm m0..m5 (member flags, chair
#                       first) leader me (1 member, 2 invited, 0 outsider
#                       short of the resource) quota sold room over sb
#                       (suspicion band of us) conf (conference date value)
#   pww_ui_nr           reserve rows (0..6), slots pww_ui_r<k>_*: res stock cap
#                       fill days in out frame fx (fill bar x offset)
#   pww_uy_<element>    y of each flowing desk element (pww_ui_layout)
#   pww_ui_nag / pww_ui_page / pww_ui_npages / pww_ui_page_n   live agreements
#                       (active, suspended, reserved) and paging, 6 per page;
#                       slots pww_ui_l<k>_*: on id st kind res amt side (1 we
#                       buy or hold the lease) cp state civ pay (0 none, 1
#                       factories, 2 political power) wepay end open com
#                       bond (seller->buyer band 0..4, -1 unknown) route (0
#                       land, 1 sea, 2 none, -1 n/a) dsh (delivery cost %)
#   pww_ui_marked       countries carrying this viewer's marks (below)
#   flags pww_ui_desk_open (desk on the trade view), pww_ui_desk_float (desk
#                       opened from the alert strip), pww_ui_dos_open (dossier)
#
# Per country (the dossier target), viewer independent
#   pww_ui_imp_band     import reliance 0..4 (imports and mod supply bought,
#                       over consumption)
#   pww_ui_nk / pww_ui_nk_all / pww_ui_nk_more, slots pww_ui_k<k>_* (3
#                       rows, fields as the ledger slots, from the country's
#                       own perspective; route not computed)
#   pww_ui_nrv, pww_ui_rv<j>_res / _b   deepest reserves (words)
#   pww_ui_x1 / pww_ui_x2   main exports (resource index, -1 none)
#   pww_uy_dos_*        y of the dossier demand block (pww_ui_dossier_layout)
# Per country, per human viewer V (pww_ui_views, monthly), stored as var@V:
#   pww_ui_vb (stronger bond band of the two directions; soured wins),
#   pww_ui_vb0 (this country -> V), pww_ui_vb1 (V -> this country),
#   pww_ui_vr (route of this country's main export to V: 0 land, 1 sea,
#   2 none), pww_ui_vc (delivery cost word 0..3: under 3%, 10%, 20%, more)
# Per viewer, set by the dossier Poach button (HOOK for the valuation lane's
#   Poach Supplier action: a preselection it may read, never required):
#   pww_ui_poach_ag (ledger id of the deal to beat), pww_ui_poach_target
# Per country, marks set by a viewer V (V's refresh clears and rewrites them)
#   pww_ui_rd_viewer = V   V presses a live demand on this country. The
#                       coercion readout V loaded is copied here (pww_coer_rd_*
#                       and pww_patron / pww_rival) so the coercion scripted loc
#                       reads it in the dossier, where THIS and FROM are this
#                       country. Also pww_ui_rd_date, pww_ui_rd_dtype.
#   pww_ui_pr_viewer = V   this country presses a live demand on V:
#                       pww_ui_pr_date, pww_ui_pr_dtype, pww_ui_pr_tstate.
#   pww_ui_st_viewer = V   shares a live Situation with V: pww_ui_st_seat,
#                       pww_ui_st_myseat (V's seat), pww_ui_st_tmpl, pww_ui_st_res.
#
# Global
#   flag pww_ui_mkt_ready, global.pww_ui_mkt_date / _day, per resource r:
#   global.pww_ui_mkt_band_<r> (0 glut .. 6 frantic), _c1_<r> (0 none, 1 one
#   buyer, 2 two buyers bidding, 3 quiet), _b1_<r> / _b2_<r> (countries),
#   _c2_<r> (1 = a live Situation over r), _ho_<r> (its holder).
#   _c3_<r> (cartel: 1 conference, 2 in force, 3 price war).
#   global.pww_ui_sum_seq: ledger queue sequence the summaries were built at.
#   flag pww_ui_view_ready: pww_ui_views has run at least once.
#
# Dates: a date value is hours since year -5000 divided by 100000, so one
#   day is 0.00024 (verified in game: 45 days from 1 January 1936 renders
#   15 February, 1936 with GetDateStringNoHourLong).
###############################################################################

pww_ui_on_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = pww_ui_sum_ready }
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.pww_ui_sum_seq = global.pww_lq_next_seq } }
				}
			}
			pww_ui_summaries = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = pww_ui_view_ready } }
			pww_ui_views = yes
		}
		pww_ui_refresh = yes
	}
}

pww_ui_on_monthly = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_age = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_age = global.pww_ui_mkt_day }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = pww_ui_mkt_ready }
				check_variable = { pww_ui_age > 27 }
			}
		}
		pww_ui_market_report = yes
		pww_ui_summaries = yes
		pww_ui_views = yes
	}
}

# Temp pww_ui_ms (0..100 score) -> temp pww_ui_mb (market band 1..6).
pww_ui_band_from_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mb = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ms > 69 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mb = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ms > 49 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mb = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ms > 34 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mb = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ms > 19 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mb = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ms > 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mb = 2 }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Country summaries (dossier, viewer independent)
pww_ui_summaries = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		pww_ui_country_summary = yes
	}
	set_variable = { global.pww_ui_sum_seq = global.pww_lq_next_seq }
	set_global_flag = pww_ui_sum_ready
}

pww_ui_country_summary = {
	pww_ui_import_sums = yes
	set_variable = { pww_ui_nk = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_nk_all = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = pww_ag_ids
		value = pww_ui_v
		if = {
			limit = { pww_ui_ag_is_live = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.pww_ag_status^pww_ui_v = 1 }
					check_variable = { global.pww_ag_kind^pww_ui_v = 0 }
					check_variable = { global.pww_ag_buyer^pww_ui_v = THIS }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = global.pww_ag_amount^pww_ui_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_nk < 3 } }
				pww_ui_load_ag = yes
				pww_ui_store_k_slot = yes
				add_to_variable = { pww_ui_nk = 1 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { pww_ui_nk_all = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { pww_ui_nk_more = pww_ui_nk_all }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_ui_nk_more = pww_ui_nk }
	pww_ui_country_trade_words = yes
	pww_ui_dossier_layout = yes
	set_variable = { pww_ui_imp_band = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_con > 0.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ratio = pww_ui_imp }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ratio = pww_ui_con }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ratio > 0.749 } }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_imp_band = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ratio > 0.499 } }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_imp_band = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ratio > 0.249 } }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_imp_band = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ratio > 0.099 } }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_imp_band = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Record loaders. Country scope = the perspective; in pww_ui_v (id).
pww_ui_load_sit = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_in_sit_id = pww_ui_v }
	pww_sit_seat_of_this = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_id = pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_seat = pww_out_seat }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_tmpl = global.pww_sit_template^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_res = global.pww_sit_res^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_days = global.pww_sit_days_left^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_phase = global.pww_sit_phase^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_tstate = global.pww_sit_tstate^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pledge = global.pww_sit_pledge^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_dev = global.pww_sit_dev^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_hasp = global.pww_sit_has_patron^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_cl = global.pww_sit_claimant^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_ho = global.pww_sit_holder^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pa = global.pww_sit_patron^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_date = pww_ui_t_days }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_date = 0.00024 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_date = global.date }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_tmpl = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_seat = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_tstate = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_tstate = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_seat = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_phase = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_seat = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_pledge = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 6 }
		}
	}
}

pww_ui_load_ag = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_id = pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_st = global.pww_ag_status^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = global.pww_ag_kind^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_res = global.pww_ag_res^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_amt = global.pww_ag_amount^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_state = global.pww_ag_state^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_com = global.pww_ag_committal^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_civ = global.pww_ag_civ^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pp = global.pww_ag_pp^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_b = global.pww_ag_buyer^pww_ui_v }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_b = THIS } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_side = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_cp = global.pww_ag_seller^pww_ui_v }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_side = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_cp = pww_ui_t_b }
	}
	# Payment: positive amounts are paid by the buyer, negative by the seller.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pay = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_wepay = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sign = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_civ = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pay = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sign = pww_ui_t_civ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_pp = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pay = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sign = pww_ui_t_pp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { pww_ui_t_sign > 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_ui_t_side = 1 }
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { pww_ui_t_sign < 0 }
					check_variable = { pww_ui_t_side = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_wepay = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_civ < 0 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_civ = -1 }
	}
	# Bond of the ordered pair (seller -> buyer); delivery route only when the
	# caller sets temp pww_ui_want_route = 1 (the viewer's own Deals rows).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_bond = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_route = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_dsh = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_in_seller = global.pww_ag_seller^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_in_buyer = global.pww_ag_buyer^pww_ui_v }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_rel_loaded }
		meta_effect = { text = { pww_rel_get = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_bond = pww_rel_band }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = pww_logi_loaded
			check_variable = { pww_ui_want_route = 1 }
			check_variable = { pww_ui_t_kind = 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_resource = pww_ui_t_res }
		meta_effect = { text = { pww_logi_delivered_cost = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_route = pww_logi_route }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_dsh = pww_logi_cost_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_dsh = 100 }
		round_temp_variable = pww_ui_t_dsh
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_end = global.pww_ag_end^pww_ui_v }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_open = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_t_end < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_open = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_end = global.num_days }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_end = 0.00024 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_end = global.date }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-player refresh (country scope: a human player).
pww_ui_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_ui_focus } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_focus = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_ui_tab } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_tab = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_ui_tabf0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_tabf1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_tabf2 = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_tab = 0 } } set_variable = { pww_ui_tabf0 = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_tab = 1 } } set_variable = { pww_ui_tabf1 = 2 } }
	else = { set_variable = { pww_ui_tabf2 = 2 } }
	# Situations in our seats (live only; the noise cap keeps it to four)
	set_variable = { pww_ui_ns = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_sit_loaded }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = pww_my_situations
			value = pww_ui_v
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ns < 4 } }
				pww_ui_load_sit = yes
				pww_ui_store_sit_slot = yes
				add_to_variable = { pww_ui_ns = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_focus < pww_ui_ns } } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_focus = -1 }
	}
	# Agreements ledger: count, clamp the page, fill this page's rows
	pww_ui_clear_ag_slots = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_want_route = 1 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_nag = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = pww_ag_ids
		value = pww_ui_v
		if = {
			limit = { pww_ui_ag_is_live = yes }
			add_to_variable = { pww_ui_nag = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_rem = pww_ui_nag }
	modulo_temp_variable = { pww_ui_rem = 6 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_npages = pww_ui_nag }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_ui_npages = pww_ui_rem }
	divide_variable = { pww_ui_npages = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_rem > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { pww_ui_npages = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_page < pww_ui_npages } } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_page = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_ui_page_n = pww_ui_page }
	add_to_variable = { pww_ui_page_n = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_first = pww_ui_page }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_first = 6 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = pww_ag_ids
		value = pww_ui_v
		if = {
			limit = { pww_ui_ag_is_live = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_lslot = pww_ui_c }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_lslot = pww_ui_first }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_ui_lslot > -1 }
					check_variable = { pww_ui_lslot < 6 }
				}
				pww_ui_load_ag = yes
				pww_ui_store_ag_slot = yes
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_want_route = 0 }
	pww_ui_load_cartels = yes
	pww_ui_load_reserves = yes
	pww_ui_layout = yes
	pww_ui_mark_counterparts = yes
	add_to_variable = { pww_ui_dirty = 1 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cartel rows (viewer scope): every live cartel (conference or in force) the
# viewer is in or invited to, or that holds a resource the viewer is short of.
pww_ui_load_cartels = {
	set_variable = { pww_ui_nc = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_cartel_loaded }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = global.pww_cart_live
			value = pww_ui_cv
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_nc < 3 } }
				pww_ui_load_cartel = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { pww_ui_t_me > 0 }
							check_variable = { pww_ui_t_short = 1 }
						}
					}
					pww_ui_store_cart_slot = yes
					add_to_variable = { pww_ui_nc = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Viewer scope. In temp pww_ui_cv (cartel id). Out pww_ui_t_* (cartel slot
# fields, see the header) and pww_ui_t_short.
pww_ui_load_cartel = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_id = pww_ui_cv }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_res = global.pww_cart_res^pww_ui_cv }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_frame = pww_ui_t_res }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_frame = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_status = global.pww_cart_status^pww_ui_cv }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_anchor = global.pww_cart_anchor^pww_ui_cv }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pct = global.pww_cart_price^pww_ui_cv }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pct = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_pct = 100 }
	round_temp_variable = pww_ui_t_pct
	set_temp_variable = { pww_band_value = global.pww_cart_cohesion^pww_ui_cv }
	meta_effect = { text = { pww_cartel_band = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_cb = pww_band }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_n = global.pww_cart_n^pww_ui_cv }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_leader = global.pww_cart_leader^pww_ui_cv }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_conf = global.pww_cart_conf_day^pww_ui_cv }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_conf = global.num_days }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_conf = 0.00024 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_conf = global.date }
	pww_ui_short_of = yes
	# members: chair first, then the others in entry order (status 1)
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_nm = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mv = pww_ui_t_leader }
	pww_ui_cart_add_flag = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_me = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_quota = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sold = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_room = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_over = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sb = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = global.pww_cm_cart
		value = pww_ui_cc
		index = pww_ui_ci
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_cc = pww_ui_cv } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_cs = global.pww_cm_status^pww_ui_ci }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_mv = global.pww_cm_who^pww_ui_ci }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_ui_cs = 1 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_mv = pww_ui_t_leader } }
				}
				pww_ui_cart_add_flag = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { pww_ui_mv = THIS }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_ui_cs = 0 }
						check_variable = { pww_ui_cs = 1 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_me = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_cs = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_me = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_quota = global.pww_cm_quota^pww_ui_ci }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sold = global.pww_cm_sold^pww_ui_ci }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_over = global.pww_cm_over^pww_ui_ci }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_room = pww_ui_t_quota }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_room = pww_ui_t_sold }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_band_value = global.pww_cm_susp^pww_ui_ci }
				meta_effect = { text = { pww_cartel_band = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_t_sb = pww_band }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dossier values that depend on the viewer, for every human viewer, stored on
# each country as var@viewer (the dossier reads var@ROOT). Monthly, and once
# on the first day.
pww_ui_views = {
	set_global_flag = pww_ui_view_ready
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_h = THIS }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
			}
			pww_ui_view_of = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (a possible dossier target). In temp pww_ui_h (the viewer).
pww_ui_view_of = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_rel_loaded }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_seller = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_buyer = pww_ui_h }
		meta_effect = { text = { pww_rel_get = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_b0 = pww_rel_band }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_o0 = pww_rel_out }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_seller = pww_ui_h }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_buyer = THIS }
		meta_effect = { text = { pww_rel_get = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_vb0@var:pww_ui_h = pww_ui_b0 }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_vb1@var:pww_ui_h = pww_rel_band }
		# a soured bond shows whichever side it is on; else the stronger one
		set_variable = { pww_ui_vb@var:pww_ui_h = pww_ui_b0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_b0 = 4 } }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { pww_rel_band = 4 }
					check_variable = { pww_rel_out > pww_ui_o0 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { pww_ui_vb@var:pww_ui_h = pww_rel_band }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = pww_logi_loaded
			check_variable = { pww_ui_x1 > -1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_seller = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_buyer = pww_ui_h }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_in_resource = pww_ui_x1 }
		meta_effect = { text = { pww_logi_delivered_cost = [Y] } Y = "yes" }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_vr@var:pww_ui_h = pww_logi_route }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_vc@var:pww_ui_h = 3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_logi_cost_share < 0.03 } } set_variable = { pww_ui_vc@var:pww_ui_h = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_logi_cost_share < 0.1 } } set_variable = { pww_ui_vc@var:pww_ui_h = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_logi_cost_share < 0.2 } } set_variable = { pww_ui_vc@var:pww_ui_h = 2 } }
	}
}

# Country scope (the viewer). Rewrites the viewer's marks on other countries.
pww_ui_mark_counterparts = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = pww_ui_marked
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_rd_viewer = PREV } }
			clear_variable = pww_ui_rd_viewer
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_pr_viewer = PREV } }
			clear_variable = pww_ui_pr_viewer
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_st_viewer = PREV } }
			clear_variable = pww_ui_st_viewer
		}
	}
	clear_array = pww_ui_marked
	# Shared live Situations
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_sit_loaded }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = pww_my_situations
			value = pww_ui_v
			set_temp_variable = { pww_in_sit_id = pww_ui_v }
			pww_sit_seat_of_this = yes
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_myseat = pww_out_seat }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_tt = global.pww_sit_template^pww_ui_v }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_tr = global.pww_sit_res^pww_ui_v }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_x = global.pww_sit_claimant^pww_ui_v }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_xs = 0 }
			pww_ui_mark_seat = yes
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_x = global.pww_sit_holder^pww_ui_v }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_xs = 1 }
			pww_ui_mark_seat = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.pww_sit_has_patron^pww_ui_v = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_x = global.pww_sit_patron^pww_ui_v }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_xs = 2 }
				pww_ui_mark_seat = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# Live demands we press (readout) or face (pressure)
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = pww_coer_loaded }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = pww_coer_dem_ids
			value = pww_ui_v
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_dst = global.pww_cd_status^pww_ui_v }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { pww_ui_dst = 0 }
						check_variable = { pww_ui_dst = 5 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ddate = global.pww_cd_deadline^pww_ui_v }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ddate = global.num_days }
				multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ddate = 0.00024 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ddate = global.date }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_dtype = global.pww_cd_type^pww_ui_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.pww_cd_claimant^pww_ui_v = THIS } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_demand_id = pww_ui_v }
					pww_coer_load_readout = yes
					pww_ui_readout_to_temps = yes
					set_variable = { pww_ui_scope = global.pww_cd_target^pww_ui_v }
					var:pww_ui_scope = {
						pww_ui_readout_from_temps = yes
						set_variable = { pww_ui_rd_viewer = PREV }
						set_variable = { pww_ui_rd_date = pww_ui_ddate }
						set_variable = { pww_ui_rd_dtype = pww_ui_dtype }
					}
					add_to_array = { array = pww_ui_marked value = pww_ui_scope }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.pww_cd_target^pww_ui_v = THIS } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_dts = global.pww_cd_tstate^pww_ui_v }
					set_variable = { pww_ui_scope = global.pww_cd_claimant^pww_ui_v }
					var:pww_ui_scope = {
						set_variable = { pww_ui_pr_viewer = PREV }
						set_variable = { pww_ui_pr_date = pww_ui_ddate }
						set_variable = { pww_ui_pr_dtype = pww_ui_dtype }
						set_variable = { pww_ui_pr_tstate = pww_ui_dts }
					}
					add_to_array = { array = pww_ui_marked value = pww_ui_scope }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Viewer scope. In temps pww_ui_x (country), pww_ui_xs (its seat),
# pww_ui_myseat, pww_ui_tt (template), pww_ui_tr (resource).
pww_ui_mark_seat = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_ui_x > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { pww_ui_x = THIS } }
		}
		set_variable = { pww_ui_scope = pww_ui_x }
		var:pww_ui_scope = {
			set_variable = { pww_ui_st_viewer = PREV }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_st_seat = pww_ui_xs }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_st_myseat = pww_ui_myseat }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_st_tmpl = pww_ui_tt }
			set_variable = { pww_ui_st_res = pww_ui_tr }
		}
		add_to_array = { array = pww_ui_marked value = pww_ui_scope }
	}
}
